user_intent: Multi-source cryptocurrency pricing infrastructure visualized as Renaissance-era technical manuscript illustration

subject.description: Intricate clockwork-style mechanism at center representing the pricing engine, with multiple gear systems and balance scales, drawn in detailed ink cross-hatching style
Four ornate channels or aqueducts feeding into the central mechanism from different directions, each carrying symbolic representations of data sources, rendered as architectural cross-sections
Renaissance-era scientific instruments scattered around - astrolabes, balance scales, measuring devices - representing precision and accuracy in financial measurement

scene.location: Aged parchment or vellum manuscript page with subtle foxing and wear marks
background_elements: faint grid lines like architectural drawings

video_prompt.narrative_concept: Chaotic price data streams converge through precision clockwork into a single balanced measurement

scenes.description: Four separate brass clockwork channels, each receiving different streams of numerical inscriptions on parchment ribbons, gears initially spinning at conflicting speeds
scenes.motion: Each mechanism operates independently, slight discord in rhythm
scenes.focal_point: The divergent ticker ribbons showing different values

scenes.description: The channels merge into a central clockwork hub, gears meshing and synchronizing, balance scales in the center begin weighing and comparing the inputs
scenes.motion: Gears gradually align, ribbons feed into central mechanism, balance scales oscillate then stabilize
scenes.focal_point: The convergence point where streams unify

scenes.description: A single brass stylus inscribes the final reconciled value onto fresh parchment, balance scales perfectly level, all gears turning in harmony
scenes.motion: Stylus moves deliberately across parchment, gentle steam wisps rise from mechanism
scenes.focal_point: The inscription being written - the authoritative price

environment.setting: Renaissance workshop with astronomical instruments on wooden tables
environment.lighting: Golden hour sunlight streaming through leaded windows, side-lit
environment.atmosphere: Faint dust motes in light beams, warm amber tones

style.medium: Animated ink and watercolor on aged parchment
style.color_palette: Sepia, brass gold, deep brown, cream parchment
style.texture: Visible paper grain, foxing at edges, ink bleeding slightly

motion_language.camera_movement: Slow dolly from wide establishing to tight on final inscription
motion_language.subject_animation: Smooth gear rotation, ribbon feed, scale oscillation dampening to stillness
